presets.name: bass
presets.doc: A fat mono-style bass: a saw with its sub and a pulse an octave down through one resonant, driven low-pass that snaps shut under its envelope.

presets.name: lead
presets.doc: A singing lead: a saw doubled by a slightly sharp second saw, a bright low-pass that opens with the key, and a vibrato that arrives after the note has started.

presets.name: sync lead
presets.doc: The classic hard-sync lead: only the slave oscillator is heard, its pitch thrown up by an envelope against the hidden master so the timbre sweeps down on every note.

presets.name: hoover-dissonant
presets.doc: The three crows' voice: a saw left and a narrow pulse with its sub right, detuned 30 cent apart through two driven low-passes that pluck on every note; oscillator 2 scoops up a fifth into the note, a slow LFO shimmers the pulse width and a bar-long swell opens both filters.

presets.name: kick
presets.doc: An analog kick: a sine on oscillator 2 that ignores the note, swept by its envelope from two octaves up down to 65 Hz in a few tens of milliseconds, through a lightly driven low-pass, a short amp decay.

presets.name: snare
presets.doc: An analog snare: high-passed noise for the rattle on amp 1 and a triangle body at 196 Hz that drops a fourth from its strike on amp 2, both short; the note is ignored.

presets.name: hat-closed
presets.doc: An analog closed hi-hat: noise with a quiet high pulse two octaves above middle C through a resonant high-pass at 7.5 kHz, a very short decay; the note is ignored.

presets.name: hat-open
presets.doc: An analog open hi-hat: the closed hat's noise and high pulse through the same resonant high-pass, left to ring for a third of a second; the note is ignored.
